verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Advanced Voice Mode as a 'real-time convo on the go' on mobile, and ChatGPT Voice in the desktop app lets you talk through ideas and coordinate tasks across Chat, Work, and Codex without typing. Voice conversations can also be started from the floating Pets controls on macOS and Windows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational naturalness and latency.
